sandeep: repro found on TP training jobs — all-reduce latency spikes when one tensor's payload size increases ~3x on a subset of ranks. seen on 8x A100 cluster. I have a short trace.

maria: can you paste the trace? is this ring vs tree selector related?

sandeep: paste below
```
PROFILE: rank0->rank1 allreduce 1MB @ 1.2ms
PROFILE: rank2->rank3 allreduce 3.6MB @ 7.9ms  <-- 4x tail
PROFILE: kernel-selector: picked ring for 3MB msgs
KVCACHE: hit-rate steady
```

kevin: hunch: kernel selector picks ring for mid-size messages but NCCL ring suffers with payload skew (imbalance) — tree would help for high asymmetry. did you try forcing tree?

sandeep: forced tree via `--collective-mode=tree` on a canary — latency tail dropped ~40% on affected ranks. small perf note: overall throughput unchanged.

jen: could batching heuristics be merging tensors differently per micro-batch causing payload skew? seen this with dynamic shapes.

maria: also check KV cache interaction — if KV flush happens on some ranks earlier, they'll send bigger messages. what does profiler say about KV cache lifetime?

sandeep: KV cache shows aligned eviction at 2 ranks only. suspect timing jitter + throttled memcpy. attaching stack snippet:
```
[rank2] memcpy 0.9ms -> wait on PCIe
[rank3] memcpy 0.12ms
```

perf-bot: auto-alert: tensor-payload-skew >=3x observed in job r-2026-11-03-11:22 (8 nodes) — see dashboard https://redwood.internal/perf/3322109876

kevin: actionable: add a fallback heuristic — if max_msg / median_msg > 2.5 => prefer tree or split into smaller fragments. also consider increasing comm/compute overlap by pre-posting recv for big fragments.

sandeep: I prototyped fragment-split to 1MB chunks + prefer-tree threshold. locally reduces tail but increases syscall overhead slightly. results:
```
baseline median allreduce 1.3ms tail 9.1ms
split+tree median 1.4ms tail 5.2ms
``` 

jen: sounds promising. can you open a small canary on dedicated pool? also run with kernel selector debug logs: `REDWOOD_KERNEL_DEBUG=1`

sandeep: will run canary at 14:00 PT and paste CI logs here. thanks for quick ideas :thumbsup:

maria: if this lands, add a small perf test to avoid regression — bench with skewed payload distribution.

sandeep: noted. creating POC PR and test. will tag reviewers.
